description: Source code for modem chat handling in Zephyr OS, including parsing, script execution, and communication via modem pipe.

methods.name: modem_chat_log_received_command
methods.description: Logs the received command arguments if logging is enabled.

methods.name: modem_chat_script_stop
methods.description: Stops the current script execution, handles cleanup, and signals completion.

methods.name: modem_chat_set_script_send_state
methods.description: Sets the current send state and resets send position.

methods.name: modem_chat_script_send
methods.description: Initiates sending the current script command.

methods.name: modem_chat_script_set_response_matches
methods.description: Sets the response matches for the current script chat.

methods.name: modem_chat_script_clear_response_matches
methods.description: Clears response matches.

methods.name: modem_chat_script_next
methods.description: Advances to the next script chat, starting or completing the current one.

methods.name: modem_chat_script_start
methods.description: Starts executing a script.

methods.name: modem_chat_script_run_handler
methods.description: Handler to start script execution.

methods.name: modem_chat_script_timeout_handler
methods.description: Handles script timeout, stops script.

methods.name: modem_chat_script_abort_handler
methods.description: Handles script abort request.

methods.name: modem_chat_script_chat_is_no_response
methods.description: Checks if current script chat expects no response.

methods.name: modem_chat_script_chat_get_send_timeout
methods.description: Gets the send timeout for current script chat.

methods.name: modem_chat_send_script_request_part
methods.description: Sends part of the script request.

methods.name: modem_chat_script_send_handler
methods.description: Handles sending script data.

methods.name: modem_chat_script_send_timeout_handler
methods.description: Handles send timeout.

methods.name: modem_chat_parse_reset
methods.description: Resets parsing parameters.

methods.name: modem_chat_parse_save_match
methods.description: Saves an exact match at the end of receive buffer.

methods.name: modem_chat_match_matches_received
methods.description: Checks if received buffer matches a given pattern.

methods.name: modem_chat_parse_find_match
methods.description: Finds a matching command in the received buffer.

methods.name: modem_chat_parse_is_separator
methods.description: Checks if the last byte is a separator.

methods.name: modem_chat_parse_end_del_start
methods.description: Checks if the end delimiter has started.

methods.name: modem_chat_parse_end_del_complete
methods.description: Checks if the end delimiter is complete.

methods.name: modem_chat_on_command_received_unsol
methods.description: Handles unsolicited command callback.

methods.name: modem_chat_on_command_received_abort
methods.description: Handles abort command callback and stops script.

methods.name: modem_chat_on_command_received_resp
methods.description: Handles response command callback and advances script.

methods.name: modem_chat_parse_find_catch_all_match
methods.description: Finds a catch-all match pattern.

methods.name: modem_chat_on_command_received
methods.description: Processes a received command based on match type.

methods.name: modem_chat_on_unknown_command_received
methods.description: Handles unknown command reception.

methods.name: modem_chat_process_byte
methods.description: Processes a single byte of received data.

methods.name: modem_chat_discard_byte
methods.description: Determines if a byte should be discarded based on filter.

methods.name: modem_chat_process_bytes
methods.description: Processes a chunk of received bytes.

methods.name: modem_chat_process_handler
methods.description: Main handler for processing incoming data.

methods.name: modem_chat_pipe_callback
methods.description: Callback for modem pipe events.

methods.name: modem_chat_init
methods.description: Initializes the modem chat context.

methods.name: modem_chat_attach
methods.description: Attaches a modem pipe to the chat context.

methods.name: modem_chat_run_script_async
methods.description: Starts executing a script asynchronously.

methods.name: modem_chat_run_script
methods.description: Runs a script synchronously, waiting for completion.

methods.name: modem_chat_script_abort
methods.description: Aborts the current script.

methods.name: modem_chat_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the chat context.
